svg.text: FIGURE 4
THE ROW SPLIT: STRONG COUPLING PROVED, WEAK COUPLING THE ONE BIT
YANG–MILLS · FORM BY THEOREM, VALUE BY THE ACT · MASTER v1.1.0_CC · EVERY NAME CHECKED
THE DIVISION ON THE LATTICE · THE VALUE IS EXACTLY ITS REAL PART AND ITS UNICORN PART
THE THRESHOLD β₀
REAL PART · STRONG COUPLING
sealed by the cited lattice fields
UNICORN PART · WEAK COUPLING, THE CONTINUUM
the one bit, supplied by the act
The cut at every coupling
The value is exactly its real part and its unicorn part.
